scope: Instagram grid and cover evidence for a local, unpublished 180-post design. Only primary sources support verified claims. No account UI was inspected by this research agent.

verified_primary_evidence.title: Instagram introduces profile grid pinning
verified_primary_evidence.finding: Instagram announced that up to three feed posts or Reels can be pinned at the top of a profile. The article also describes unpinning.
verified_primary_evidence.limit: This verifies the published feature, not the current account's pinned posts, pin order or interface.

verified_primary_evidence.title: Inspiring Creativity That Brings People Together
verified_primary_evidence.finding: Meta announced the intention to let people reorder their profile posts.
verified_primary_evidence.limit: The text uses future tense. It alone does not establish current availability or current account behavior.

primary_sources_located_but_not_verified.title: Image resolution of photos you share on Instagram
primary_sources_located_but_not_verified.access_result: Direct Help Center request returned 429; Facebook Help mirror redirected to a login/block page.
primary_sources_located_but_not_verified.claim_pending_primary_or_account_verific: Current accepted native photo aspect range and resolution, including 3:4 photos. Do not label exact dimensions as officially verified from this research.

primary_sources_located_but_not_verified.title: Reel size and aspect ratios on Instagram
primary_sources_located_but_not_verified.access_result: Direct Help Center request returned 429; Facebook Help mirror redirected to a login/block page.
primary_sources_located_but_not_verified.claim_pending_primary_or_account_verific: Accepted Reel ratios, minimum resolution/frame rate, recommended cover size and post-publication cover editing. design_assumptions_not_platform_guarante.feed_canvas: 1080 x 1440 (3:4) may be used as a provisional local design canvas, with a 1080 x 1350 (4:5) adaptation if the actual publishing route requires it. Verify the route before export lock.
design_assumptions_not_platform_guarante.reel_canvas: 1080 x 1920 (9:16) is a chosen production canvas. Treat the cover, profile thumbnail and full-screen Reel as separate compositions and previews.
design_assumptions_not_platform_guarante.grid_model: Use 3:4 as a labelled provisional profile-thumbnail model; also stress-test 1:1 and 4:5 crops. These are design tests, not a claim that every Instagram surface currently uses those ratios.
design_assumptions_not_platform_guarante.artwork_integrity: Keep an uncropped source master. Use contain/padding when showing an entire work; identify intentional details as details. Never stretch an artwork to a canvas ratio.
design_assumptions_not_platform_guarante.critical_content: Place essential visual information and any text away from edges as a project design choice. No universal officially verified safe-zone coordinates were recovered.
design_assumptions_not_platform_guarante.grid_order: Simulate newest-first publication order and explicit pin states. Do not build a puzzle that requires perfect alignment or rely on unverified reorder availability.
design_assumptions_not_platform_guarante.route_difference: Native app, desktop, Business Suite and API constraints must be checked separately; do not infer API acceptance from native app acceptance.

publication_preview_checks: Record the actual account's current visible grid, pins and interface before merging a plan with existing posts.
In the intended publishing route, inspect the full feed post, each carousel page, Reel cover, profile thumbnail and full-screen Reel separately.
Confirm crop position, cover choice and any Adjust Preview control in the actual account; do not assume desktop and mobile controls match.
Verify text legibility, artwork edges, faces, signatures and intentional detail labels at thumbnail size.
Verify current pinned-row order against each simulated grid state and ensure pinned posts are not duplicated in the model.
Keep preview-checked status separate from local-file-generated status. These checks are QA before publication, not a new permission request.
risk_statement: A complete local preview reduces composition and sequencing risk; it cannot guarantee platform rendering, future feature stability, reach or growth. No posting or account mutation was performed by this research task.
